citations.claim: first violation: body centre reached wall face x=10 with 0.249 overlap exceeding 0.15 limit
one step earlier body was 2m away, so 60 m/s step drove it into the wall

explanation: Fast body (60 m/s, dt=1/30 => 2m/step) strikes the side face of wall box head-on. Despite 68 substeps, impulse plus positional correction fails to resolve the side contact, leaving the circle embedded with 0.249 overlap > 0.15 tolerance at step 3.
vision_note: The red circle approaches the tall grey wall from the left across steps 0-2, then at step 3 it is sitting overlapping the top corner of the wall. It fails to deflect and remains embedded in the wall instead of staying outside it.
